$comment: LCARdS 2026.11.0: generated from src/cards/schemas/ by scripts/generate-llm-schema.js; do not hand-edit.
description: Action to perform on interaction (tap, hold, or double-tap). Supports toggle, service calls, navigation, more-info dialog, or no action.

action.description: Type of action to perform (no default: an action without it does nothing). fire-dom-event: fire Home Assistant's ll-custom event with this action (browser_mod listens for it). fly-to: fly the camera of the astrometrics card named in card to its view or point. set-clock: set the scene date and or rate of the astrometrics card named in card. set-model-scale: draw its models at their real size, or larger to stay visible (model_scale). point-card: open, close or toggle the card pinned to one of its points (point, point_card).
enumDescriptions: Set an astrometrics card's scene date and rate
Change an astrometrics card's model scale
Open or close the card on an astrometrics point

pipeline_id.description: assist: the Assist pipeline to open (its id, or preferred)

start_listening.description: assist: start listening for speech when the dialog opens

perform_action.description: Action to perform (format: domain.action); the current Home Assistant name for service

data.description: Data for the action (perform-action), such as brightness for light.turn_on

navigation_path.description: Path to navigate to (must start with /)

navigation_replace.description: navigate only: replace the current page in the browser history instead of adding one, so Back skips it

confirmation.description: Ask before running the action, as Home Assistant does: true asks Home Assistant's own question, an object sets the text and buttons and who is not asked. Works on every action type.

anyOf.description: true: ask with Home Assistant's default question
The question, its buttons and who is not asked

text.description: The question (default: Home Assistant's "Are you sure you want to run action ...?" naming the action)

exemptions.description: Users who are not asked: the action runs straight away for them

user.description: A Home Assistant user id (Settings > People > Users with advanced mode on, the user's ID)

url_path.description: url only: the address to open, in a new tab

target.description: What the action acts on: entity_id, device_id, area_id, floor_id or label_id (and exclude), passed to Home Assistant as the action's target

browser_mod.description: fire-dom-event: what browser_mod runs, in its own grammar (service and data, e.g. service: browser_mod.popup), read from the ll-custom event

card.description: fly-to, set-clock, set-model-scale and point-card: the id of the astrometrics card to act on (any card on the same dashboard or open in the same browser). On the astrometrics card's own points and objects, leave it out for that card.

view.description: fly-to only: a named view of that card (camera.views).

point.description: fly-to: a point id of that card to fly to (wins over view). point-card: the point whose card opens or closes (on the astrometrics card's own point, leave it out for that point).

duration.description: fly-to only: how long the flight takes, ms. Default the card's camera.fly_duration.

warp.description: fly-to only: stars and dust streak on the way (warp), or false for none. Default the view's own warp, else the card's camera.warp.

date.description: set-clock only: the scene date, now or an ISO date and time (2026-10-30, 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z). Leave out to keep the date running on.

rate.description: set-clock only: how fast the scene date runs, days per second (1 is a day a second, 0 holds it, negative runs back), or live for real time. Leave out to keep the rate.

model_scale.description: set-model-scale only: real draws the card's models at their real size, visible draws small ones at least 40 px across, toggle (the default) switches between them. Not saved.

point_card.description: point-card: open, close or toggle (the default) the point's card (a card with show: tap; one is open at a time). fly-to with a point: open (or close, toggle) its card as the camera flies there.
